data.title: Bitcoin News: BlackRock Just Moved $262 Million in Bitcoin to Coinbase. Is More Selling Coming?
data.description: Wallets tied to BlackRock’s (NYSE: BLK) spot ETFs moved 3,215 BTC, valued at $262.4 million, to Coinbase Prime, according to on-chain records from October 23, 2026. Coinbase Prime, Coinbase’s institutional trading desk (NASDAQ: COIN), also received another 38,882 ETH, worth $93.2 million, from those wallets. This brings the total transfer to about $355.6 million in just […]
